name: Bitmap Studio
description: A pro photo-grading darkroom: film looks, third-party .cube LUTs, brand-seeded colour treatments and finishing texture — then bake your look as a LUT any editor can use.

featured.blurb: Grade photos with film looks, LUTs and your brand colours

inputs.label: Image
inputs.help: Pick a photo or upload your own. Everything is processed on your device — the pixels never leave the browser. Leave empty to grade the built-in demo scene, or hit “Go live” to grade your camera.

inputs.label: Zoom & Position
inputs.help: Zoom scales the photo up; X / Y pan it within the frame. Drag a label or type a value.

inputs.label: Temperature
inputs.help: White balance: negative cools the image toward blue, positive warms it toward amber.

inputs.label: Tint
inputs.help: White balance: negative shifts toward green, positive toward magenta.

inputs.label: Exposure
inputs.help: Brightness in photographic stops (EV), applied in linear light like a camera.

inputs.label: Contrast
inputs.help: A smooth S-curve around mid-grey — push the tones apart or flatten them.

inputs.label: Highlights
inputs.help: Recover blown skies (negative) or push the bright end brighter (positive).

inputs.label: Shadows
inputs.help: Lift detail out of the darks (positive) or deepen them (negative).

inputs.label: Saturation
inputs.help: 0 = greyscale · 100 = original · 200 = vivid.

inputs.label: Vibrance
inputs.help: Smart saturation: boosts muted colours first and eases off where colour is already rich.

inputs.label: Film look
inputs.help: Original film-inspired looks built from open, procedural curves — no sampled stock, so they're safe to ship anywhere.

inputs.label: Look strength
inputs.help: Blend between the untouched image (0) and the full look (100).

inputs.label: LUT file (.cube / .3dl)
inputs.help: Load a third-party colour LUT — Adobe/IRIDAS .cube (1D or 3D) or Autodesk .3dl. Applied on your device with tetrahedral interpolation, after Develop and the film look.

inputs.label: LUT intensity
inputs.help: Blend between the un-LUTted image (0) and the full LUT (100).

inputs.label: Baked LUT size
inputs.help: Grid size of the .cube this tool bakes. 33 is the industry default and loads everywhere.

inputs.label: Download look as .cube
inputs.help: Bakes the whole colour pipeline — Develop, film look, loaded LUT and brand treatment — into one .cube LUT for DaVinci Resolve, Premiere, Final Cut or Photoshop, and downloads it. The switch flips itself back off. Texture effects (grain, vignette…) are spatial and can't live in a LUT.

inputs.label: Treatment
inputs.help: Colour treatments seeded from your brand palette. Leave the colours below empty to auto-pick from the brand's tokens; set them to override.

inputs.label: Treatment amount
inputs.help: Blend between the untreated image (0) and the full treatment (100).

inputs.label: Shadow colour
inputs.help: Empty = auto: the darkest colour in your brand palette.

inputs.label: Midtone colour
inputs.help: Empty = auto: the most colourful swatch in your brand palette.

inputs.label: Highlight colour
inputs.help: Empty = auto: the lightest colour in your brand palette.

inputs.label: Film grain
inputs.help: Seeded, luminance-weighted monochrome grain — strongest in the midtones, like real stock.

inputs.label: Grain size
inputs.help: Clump size of the grain in pixels.

inputs.label: Vignette
inputs.help: Gently darken the corners to pull the eye inward.

inputs.label: Bloom
inputs.help: Soft glow spilling from the brightest areas.

inputs.label: Halation
inputs.help: The warm red-orange halo film prints around hot highlights.

inputs.label: Chromatic aberration
inputs.help: Lens-style colour fringing that grows toward the corners.

inputs.label: Sharpen
inputs.help: Unsharp-mask crispness. A little goes a long way.

inputs.label: Dust & scratches
inputs.help: Seeded specks, fibres and hairline scratches — the imperfections of a well-loved print.

inputs.label: Seed
inputs.help: Re-rolls the grain and dust patterns. The same seed always gives the same result.

inputs.label: Before / after split
inputs.help: Show the untouched image on the left half and the graded result on the right. Exports exactly as shown — handy for approval decks.

inputs.label: Histogram
inputs.help: Live RGB + luminance histogram over the canvas. Screen only — never part of the export.
